infra.periodHint: 0 = one-time; a payment archives the asset.
infra.anchorHint: Short months use their last day, then return to this day.
infra.confirmPayment: I have paid the supplier and confirm the expiry handling shown above.
infra.deleteHint: A record with payment history cannot be deleted. Archive the asset instead.
infra.adminOnly: Infrastructure costs are visible to administrators only.

workspace.leaveHint: Save your changes before leaving, or discard them to continue.
workspace.forbidden: You do not have access to these settings.
workspace.notFound: This settings page does not exist.
workspace.noResults: No matching settings. Try another keyword.
workspace.updateHint: View the current version and available updates.
workspace.loadError: Could not load settings. Try again before editing.
workspace.backupHint: Manage local snapshots, remote storage and backup encryption.
workspace.applicationUnknown: Running configuration is not confirmed by a current report.
workspace.publicationHint: Subscription nodes publish enabled inbounds to subscriptions. Users also need an active plan and permission to use them.

reverse.title: VLESS Reverse connections
reverse.hint: Select exit server B, then choose one or more transit servers A. B connects to A; users connect to A for authentication and accounting, and B provides the exit.
reverse.scope: B actively connects to each A. Users authenticate and are counted at A; subscriptions use A’s address and exit through B. Existing direct inbounds stay independent.
reverse.limits: Multiplexed tunnels do not support the current per-user tc speed limiter. Captain aggregates quotas after traffic reports; this is not an instantaneous global hard cap. A connected tunnel does not prove destination availability.
reverse.sniHint: Enter a REALITY target verified from each transit. TCP/TLS reachability alone is insufficient. Avoid www.microsoft.com with the current pinned core: oversized certificate records can prevent the handshake.
reverse.applyHint: Update tunnel and REALITY user SNI on all {{count}} selected connections. Other per-server settings are preserved.
reverse.removal: Deselecting a transit removes its managed listeners and subscription node when saved. Other inbounds remain. Port or protocol changes can interrupt active connections.
reverse.existingIngress: Create the ingress on the transit server first.
reverse.retryHint: Disconnected tunnels reconnect automatically; offline servers apply changes when they return. Open the transit or exit server to inspect diagnostics.
reverse.scanFrom: Detection runs from transit {{node}}. A selected target updates its tunnel and REALITY user listener.

egress.title: Private upstream exceptions
egress.hint: Allow the cores to connect to a specific upstream IP/CIDR, protocol and port. Subscriber destination restrictions stay unchanged. This applies to all cores on this server; control APIs remain protected.
egress.requiresVersion: Upgrade bosun to {{version}} or later to configure these exceptions.
egress.applyHint: After saving, check the server self-check for the applied guard status. Host configuration exceptions also apply; no restart is required.

privateAccess.title: Private network access
privateAccess.hint: Applies to all authorized users of this inbound. Limit its user group for internal use.
privateAccess.protection: Requires Linux nft and a supported sing-box/Xray server. Loopback, link-local and control APIs stay protected. Permission changes disconnect existing connections. Proxy chains, WARP and balancers are not supported.
privateAccess.portsHint: Both 0: all ports. Last port 0: first port only.
privateAccess.enforcementHint: Core-only requires explicitly disabled cores.egress_guard and a current capability report.
privateAccess.coreOnlyHint: Supports sing-box / Extended. Upgraded servers preserve existing split routing, including WARP and proxy exits. No nft destination isolation; non-root and control API protection remain required. Xray and managed reverse tunnels are unsupported. Changing policy interrupts connections.
privateAccess.confirmCoreOnly: I understand nft destination isolation is disabled and authorize this inbound to use core-only protection.

coreManager.title: Core management
coreManager.subtitle: Download versions, then choose which version each core runs.
coreManager.unavailable: Upgrade bosun to a version that reports core management support.
coreManager.offline: The server must be online to manage cores.
coreManager.readOnly: Manage this server from Captain with an administrator account.
coreManager.working: Operation in progress. Downloads can take several minutes.
coreManager.downloaded: Download completed. Existing inbounds are unchanged.
coreManager.extendedHint: Extended Mieru needs explicit selection and a client subscription refresh after switching from mita. This build only supports wildcard listening; use mita when binding a specific IP. Native mita quotas are unsupported; bosun/Captain quota enforcement remains available.
coreManager.externalHint: An explicit binary path is configured on the server. Remove that pin before switching from the panel.
coreManager.activateHint: Activate {{core}} {{version}}? Connections on this core will restart. Configuration is checked first; startup failure restores the previous version. Downloading alone does not switch cores.
coreManager.sshHint: SSH proxy supports TCP forwarding only, with per-user passwords and a generated host key. Use sing-box subscriptions for host key verification; no shell, SFTP or UDP.
coreManager.timeout: Operation timed out. Refresh to check the server before retrying.
coreManager.listenAddress: This Mieru build cannot bind a specific listening IP. Use mita.

dnsHealth.title: DNS health
dnsHealth.hint: Captain checks every 5 minutes using the panel resolver and Cloudflare (1.1.1.1). NAT and dedicated-line names use the public entry IP; shared names only need to resolve. With monitoring enabled, three failures over at least 10 minutes trigger an alert. Checks never modify DNS.
dnsHealth.empty: No domains to check. IP-only addresses do not need DNS checks.
dnsHealth.resolveOnly: Resolution only; no fixed IP comparison
dnsHealth.inconsistentHint: Answers differ: caching, propagation or location-based DNS may be involved. Failure or recovery is not confirmed.
dnsHealth.historyHint: Previous values are saved before automatic and manual A/AAAA writes and retained for 180 days. Earlier changes and changes outside Captain are not included. Unknown outcomes include in-progress or interrupted writes: verify with the provider before retrying. Previous values are for manual recovery; there is no automatic rollback.

errors.not_found: No record for this address family

dnsHealth.propagationPending: DNS records written; waiting for resolution to reflect the change. Recent writes are checked more frequently; caches may still return old answers.
dnsHealth.badgeHint: DNS resolution only, not connectivity. Checked: {{at}}. Open DNS diagnostics for details.
dnsHealth.scopeHint: A and AAAA are checked separately. A matching record does not prove the proxy port or IPv6 network is reachable. Sync DNS records is a separate provider write using saved server addresses.
dnsHealth.unexpectedHint: DNS has records for an address family without a registered expected address. Verify the server information and records at the provider.

sync.title: Sync DNS records
sync.hint: Review the saved server domain and addresses against Cloudflare before applying. This only creates or updates eligible DNS-only A/AAAA records. It does not delete records or change ingress mappings, client subscription addresses, or unsaved information. This manual sync does not change automatic DNS settings.
sync.loading: Reading saved configuration and provider records…
sync.loadError: Could not read the DNS sync plan. No records have been written.
sync.nothing: No eligible record changes to apply.
sync.changed: The server configuration or provider records changed. Reload the preview before applying.
sync.requestUnknown: The request could not confirm the final result. Review DNS change history and reload provider records before trying again.
sync.resultHint: A successful write is not a resolution or connectivity check. DNS caches may take time to update; recheck resolution separately.

reasons.no_address: No valid public address is registered.
reasons.shared_domain: This domain is shared or externally managed; Captain will not overwrite its records.
reasons.domain_address_conflict: Domain ownership or expected addresses conflict. Resolve the conflict first.
reasons.unmanaged_domain: This domain is not managed through Cloudflare in Captain.
reasons.auto_dns_disabled: Automatic DNS is disabled. Manual sync does not enable it.
reasons.external_records: The existing records are proxied or have multiple values. Manage them at the provider.
reasons.provider_unavailable: Provider records could not be read. Try again later.
reasons.unknown: No safe record change is available. Check domain settings and provider records.

nodeMode.title: Server mode
nodeMode.monitorHint: Monitor availability, system resources, network speed, traffic and latency without running proxy cores or port forwarding services. Core files downloaded before switching are retained.
nodeMode.fullHint: Monitoring and proxy services are available.
nodeMode.installHint: Monitor server availability, CPU, memory, disks, network speed and traffic, with latency checks and alerts. No proxy cores are downloaded or started, and proxy and port forwarding services are unavailable. Switch to a full server later from server details.
nodeMode.confirmFull: The agent will restart and enable its configured proxy cores. Full mode requires the host network tools (nftables/iproute2); missing prerequisites appear in diagnostics.
nodeMode.confirmMonitor: Remove all inbounds (including disabled ones), forwards, reverse links and proxy policies first. Monitoring history and existing core files are retained. The agent will restart.
nodeMode.pending: Waiting for the server to apply the change. Last reported mode: {{mode}}.
nodeMode.upgradeHint: Mode changes require an online server reporting mode support. Upgrade bosun and wait for a fresh report.

wireguard.sniHint: Used by the VLESS REALITY listener on A. The WireGuard tunnel itself does not use SNI.
wireguard.scanFrom: Scan and select a target from transit A ({{node}}).
wireguard.selectTransitToScan: Select transit server A first to auto-select a target or probe the current SNI.
wireguard.title: Reverse WireGuard
wireguard.hint: B actively connects to A. A authenticates and bills users; B provides public egress and explicitly authorized LAN access.
wireguard.requirements: Both servers need Linux WireGuard support and a fresh capability report. Users connect with VLESS REALITY. Automatic forwarding requires active UFW on B; other firewalls need manual setup. Servers requiring an ingress mapping cannot be used as A.
wireguard.endpointHint: Enter the IP and UDP port reachable from B. If NAT changes the port, enter the public mapped port here; the tunnel port above remains local.
wireguard.domainPreferenceHint: For domains with IPv4 and IPv6 answers, prefer the family B can reach. This does not provide IPv6 connectivity or convert IPv6 addresses to IPv4. A must report support to save a new preference.
wireguard.autoForwardingHint: Maintain forwarding rules for this connection on B. This also requires the server's global automatic firewall opening to be enabled. When off, manage forwarding manually. Existing manual rules are preserved.

forwardingHints.synced: B's forwarding rules were synchronized. Test client access to confirm the complete path works.
forwardingHints.external: Existing rules are preserved. Check that they permit forwarding for this connection.
forwardingHints.not_required: No active UFW or firewalld was detected. Other host rules may still block forwarding.
forwardingHints.manual: Automatic forwarding is off. Manage forwarding rules for this connection on B manually.
forwardingHints.unsupported: This firewall cannot be configured automatically. Switch to manual management and allow forwarding on B.
forwardingHints.error: Could not synchronize forwarding rules on B. Check the server error and firewall settings.
forwardingHints.unknown: No recent forwarding check is available. Upgrade B and wait for a fresh report.
forwardingHints.stale: This result is no longer current. Wait for B to check and report again.

forwardingReasons.policy_routing_unsupported: B uses routing policies that need manual forwarding setup.
forwardingReasons.route_interface_ambiguous: The outgoing interface on B is unclear. Check its routes before setting up forwarding.
forwardingReasons.private_grant_route_unavailable: B has no usable route to an authorized private network.
forwardingReasons.no_forwarding_route: B has no usable outgoing route. Check its network configuration.
forwardingReasons.ufw_forward_rule_conflict: An existing UFW rule conflicts with automatic setup. It was preserved for manual review.
forwardingReasons.owned_rule_changed_retained: An automatically managed rule was changed externally and preserved. Review the firewall rules.
forwardingReasons.inactive_backend_rules_retained: Rules from a previous firewall configuration were retained. Review them manually.
forwardingReasons.automatic_forwarding_disabled: Automatic firewall management is disabled on B. Enable it on the server or manage this connection's forwarding manually.
forwardingReasons.ufw_forward_runtime_verification_failed: Saved UFW rules do not match the active rules. Check B's firewall before retrying.

host.title: Host management
host.minimum: Requires bosun {{version}} or newer. Upgrade this server to enable host management.
host.offline: Server is offline or unpaired. Showing the last observation; changes are disabled.
host.restricted: This agent cannot manage its host (container, unsupported OS or insufficient privileges). Values describe the agent’s own environment.
host.running: Waiting for the server to execute and report…
host.verifyHint: Verify the new SSH login and sudo permissions, or confirm DNS/firewall connectivity from a separate connection. Server online status alone is not proof that SSH works.
host.verified: I verified the new access and connectivity through a separate connection.
host.historyHint: Retains up to 200 changes for 180 days. State checks do not evict changes. Refresh actual state before retrying an unknown outcome.
host.applyHint: Original settings are saved on the server before applying. Access and network changes require confirmation within ten minutes; otherwise the server attempts local recovery.

reasons.requires_native_debian_systemd: Changes require native root bosun on Debian/Ubuntu with systemd.
reasons.ssh_complex_or_socket: Conditional/custom SSH configuration or socket activation needs manual review.
reasons.requires_active_ufw: Rule changes require an already active UFW backend. Other rules remain externally managed.
reasons.requires_fail2ban_sshd: Install and configure Fail2ban before managing its SSH jail.
reasons.requires_systemd_resolved: Resolver is externally managed or uses an unsupported resolv.conf link. Modify it through its existing manager.
reasons.host_busy_or_storage: Host journal is busy or unavailable. Refresh again before making changes.
reasons.requires_admin_tools: Administrator changes require installed sudo, visudo and useradd tools.

hints.hostname: Changes the system hostname, not the Captain server name, public endpoint or DNS records. /etc/hosts remains unchanged.
hints.time: Uses the existing systemd time service. Changing timezone does not manually set the clock. Synchronization may take time.
hints.ssh: Requires a non-root administrator with a public key. Review your access before disabling password/root login. Complex Match configurations are not modified.
hints.port: Keeps both old and new ports until you confirm the new login. Allow the new local TCP port first. For NAT/cloud servers, configure the public mapping/security group with the provider before applying.
hints.admin: Adds a public key in a root-owned store and grants passwordless sudo (full root privileges). Existing administrators remain. A new account/home is retained if recovery removes its key and sudo grant. No private key is needed.
hints.firewall: Adds one UFW allow rule. Does not enable/replace the firewall or flush bosun rules. Confirm connectivity after applying.
hints.fail2ban: Changes only the sshd jail. Other jails are preserved. Settings must be accepted by Fail2ban before restarting.
hints.updates: Uses installed distribution security-update tooling. Automatic reboot remains disabled; the update timer must already be running.
hints.dns: Supports systemd-resolved or a regular resolv.conf not managed by another service. Per-link/DHCP DNS may take precedence. Domain records are unchanged; verify resolution before confirming.
hints.network: Changes the selected congestion algorithm and optionally applies supported security parameters. Does not replace qdiscs, modify WireGuard routes or change user limits.
hints.swap: Creates one dedicated swap file, preserving existing provider/Quench swap. Existing managed swap cannot be resized here; creation can fail on unsupported filesystems or insufficient space.

hostFirewall.title: Automatic listener rules
hostFirewall.hint: Follows inbound, forwarding and WG listeners; rules are removed after the last reference disappears. Does not change cloud security groups, NAT mappings or forwarding policy. Synced rules do not prove public reachability.
hostFirewall.minimum: Upgrade bosun to v0.72.0 and refresh to see rule sources and synchronization results.
hostFirewall.noReferences: No remaining references; awaiting cleanup or review

warnings.legacy_rules_retained: Old records cannot prove ownership. Existing allowances are retained and need manual review after removing their services.
warnings.ownership_conflict: External rule edits or a changed firewall backend/zone prevent automatic deletion. Review required.

nodeLayout.title: Groups and order
nodeLayout.hint: Groups and order are shared by server management and the public status page. Drag the handles or use the arrow buttons, then save. Ungrouped servers appear last. You can also drop a server onto a group card above to move it to the end of that group.
nodeLayout.deleteHint: Deleting a group moves its servers to Ungrouped; it does not delete servers.
nodeLayout.selectAll: Select all servers in this group
nodeLayout.invalidName: Group names must be unique, nonempty, at most 128 bytes, and contain no control characters or markup.
nodeLayout.conflict: Servers or groups changed elsewhere. Cancel and reopen to avoid overwriting the latest changes.
nodeLayout.publicHint: Group names appear on the public status page. Manage groups and order from the server list.

nodeRegion.hint: Captain queries Country.is using the machine public IP observed by bosun (IPv4 first). Manual choices do not follow IP changes.
nodeRegion.conflict: IPv4 reports {{ipv4}}, IPv6 reports {{ipv6}}. Automatic mode uses IPv4; you can override it manually.
nodeRegion.failed: Country lookup failed. Try again later.
nodeRegion.noIP: Waiting for bosun to report the machine public IP. Manually configured entry addresses are not used.
nodeRegion.stale: The public IP observation has expired. Wait for a fresh bosun report before detecting again.

nodeCost.amountHint: Blank hides the price; 0 means free.
nodeCost.expiryHint: Expiry date in UTC. Changing the payment cycle does not immediately extend it.
nodeCost.legacyHint: Legacy price text is preserved. Check the amount and currency when converting.
nodeCost.dateRequired: Enter an expiry date or choose a manual traffic reset day.
nodeCost.resetHint: Resets on day {{day}} each month, clamped to month end.
nodeCost.resetNextHint: Resets one day after day {{day}} each month, after clamping to month end.
nodeCost.autoRenewalHint: After expiry, a new valid report calculates the next due date from the billing cycle. This is date estimation only; it does not record or prove payment.
nodeCost.renewalDateRequired: Enter a valid expiry date first.
nodeCost.renewalCycleRequired: Switch to amount and cycle, then set a payment cycle.
nodeCost.renewalWholeMonths: Automatic expiry extension requires whole months, such as 0.5 or 1.5 years. This cycle cannot be converted exactly.
nodeCost.renewalConflict: The expiry date has changed. Your draft has not been saved. Load the latest expiry date, then review your changes before saving.

privateReady.title: Private access prerequisites
privateReady.hint: Checks installation prerequisites only. Inbound protocol, routing and successful policy application are validated separately. Recheck does not change firewall rules or restart proxies.
privateReady.unknown: No recent readiness report. Check server connectivity and upgrade bosun; wait for its next report.
privateReady.ready: Installation prerequisites passed. This does not guarantee private destination reachability.
privateReady.prepare: Run inside the server or bosun container as the service administrator. This creates only the configured non-root account and checks prerequisites; it preserves existing configuration and firewall rules. Configuration or container permission changes require restarting bosun and interrupt proxy connections.

fixes.linux: Use a Linux server for per-inbound private access.
fixes.user: Set cores.user to a dedicated non-root account, for example bosun-proxy. Run the preparation command and restart bosun. Installing bosun as root is supported.
fixes.nft: Install nftables using apt-get, apk or dnf inside the server/container. Recheck after installation.
fixes.guard: Review cores.egress_guard and enable it. Restarting bosun applies isolation and interrupts proxy connections.
fixes.allow: Review cores.egress_allow and remove global exceptions before using per-inbound grants. Restarting may block traffic previously covered by those exceptions.
fixes.capabilities: The agent needs SETUID, SETGID, SETPCAP and NET_ADMIN; proxy children need NET_BIND_SERVICE and NET_ADMIN. For standard Docker defaults add cap_add: [NET_ADMIN], then recreate the container (connections are interrupted). Do not enable privileged mode.
fixes.kernel: Run nft list tables in the bosun network namespace. Check kernel nftables support and container/service permissions; installing the command alone is insufficient.
fixes.guardDisabled: Set cores.egress_guard: false only if you intend to manage destination protection yourself, then restart bosun. Control API protection remains enabled.

privateReady.kernelPending: Kernel nftables access has not been tested. Use Recheck to verify it.

wgSetup.title: Reverse WireGuard prerequisites
wgSetup.loadError: Could not load prerequisites. Refresh before saving.
wgSetup.upgrade: Upgrade bosun to see detailed prerequisites and install missing tools from this page.
wgSetup.manual: These remaining conditions need manual configuration. Automatic installation supports native root Debian/Ubuntu, Alpine and supported dnf systems; containers and service PATH issues require manual handling.
wgSetup.installing: Installing missing packages; the server will recheck and report when finished…
wgSetup.checking: Waiting for the server to recheck and report…
wgSetup.jobFailed: The task failed or expired. Recheck the server and its system package manager before retrying.
wgSetup.installed: Dependency installation finished. Readiness above is based on the latest server report.
wgSetup.confirm: Install {{packages}} on this server using its system package manager? This installs only the missing tool packages, not the full bosun installation. Your connection form will be preserved.

errors.busy: Another dependency installation is running. Try again when it finishes.
errors.unsupported: This environment requires manual installation or service PATH correction.
errors.timeout: Installation timed out. Check the package manager before retrying.
errors.install_failed: The package manager failed. Check repository connectivity, package locks and disk space.
errors.tools_missing: Some tools are still unavailable after installation. Check the service PATH and installed packages.

entryFlow.title: Nodes and lines
entryFlow.subtitle: Publish subscription nodes and manage their server paths.
entryFlow.directHint: Use an existing inbound or create one on a server first.
entryFlow.lineHint: Select a managed line and an entry server. The endpoint follows the line configuration.
entryFlow.clientHint: The client reaches the target through an existing subscription node. Both original nodes stay unchanged.
entryFlow.clientCompatibility: Requires full subscriptions for mihomo, recent Stash or sing-box and permission to use both nodes. Both may charge traffic. Unsupported formats or unavailable predecessors omit the chain. Do not add conflicting name/tag or dialer overrides.
entryFlow.newInboundHint: Saving creates a real listening service. It remains on the server if the next step is canceled or fails.
entryFlow.inboundSaved: Inbound “{{name}}” is saved. Retrying this step reuses it.
entryFlow.createdResourcesRemain: Discard this draft? The inbound or ingress already created on the server remains available.
entryFlow.addressHint: These fields only change the client endpoint. They do not create a port forward or NAT mapping.
entryFlow.invalidDialer: Select a predecessor without a cycle. Up to 8 nodes are supported.
entryFlow.partialLoad: Some server details could not be loaded. Missing items cannot be selected.
entryFlow.ingressAlreadyCreated: An ingress was already created. Reuse its unchanged draft, or close this step and select it from the server.
entryFlow.ingressSaved: The ingress is saved and will be reused when retrying.
entryFlow.uncertainCreate: The response was interrupted; the server may have saved the resource. Close this step, refresh the server and check existing resources before creating another.
entryFlow.deleteHint: Delete this subscription node? Its inbound remains. Referenced or managed nodes must first be detached.
entryFlow.lineEndpointMissing: An entry without a public address cannot be published. Add a public address to its server or NAT / dedicated-line ingress first.
entryFlow.lineExtraAdminOnly: Only administrators can change client JSON for a node bound to a server line.

lines.scopeHint: A line forwards traffic through ordered server groups to one inbound. Saving configures servers; it does not verify end-to-end connectivity.
lines.name: Line name
lines.adminOnly: Only administrators can manage server lines.
lines.groupHint: Groups run in order. A group’s strategy and weights are applied by the preceding group. Up to 8 groups with 8 members each.
lines.entryHint: Each entry server has its own endpoint. This does not configure DNS load balancing.
lines.failoverHint: Try members in order; failover is only available for TCP multi-member groups. Selection uses next-hop TCP dial results, not a check of the entire downstream path.
lines.roundrobinHint: Distribute new connections by member weights. Existing connections remain on their selected member.
lines.targetHint: The final inbound is separate from forwarding groups. A server cannot appear twice or forward back to the final server.
lines.unmappedPort: This port has no public mapping.
lines.saveErrorHint: Your draft is retained. A version conflict requires closing and reopening the latest line.
lines.deleteHint: Remove subscription-node bindings before deleting this line. Its managed forwarding rules will be removed.
lines.probeHint: Recent next-hop observations only; they do not prove the complete client path works.
lines.protocolError: Could not determine the inbound transport.
lines.mixedGroupHint: UDP and mixed-transport groups with multiple members only support round robin.

backendHints.relay: Supports serial forwarding and weighted round robin between candidate servers. Only TCP multi-member groups support failover.
backendHints.nft: Each subsequent group must have one server. Kernel DNAT requires matching address families. Host FORWARD traffic must be allowed separately; automatic listener-port opening does not manage routed rules. No automatic engine fallback.
backendHints.realm: Runs an external relay process. Each subsequent group must have one server. No automatic engine fallback.

nodeBandwidth.title: Advertised bandwidth
nodeBandwidth.hint: Record the provider’s bandwidth capacity only; this does not change speed limits. Empty means unknown. RX is received by the server; TX is sent.
nodeBandwidth.public: Show bandwidth on the public status page

loginClients.title: Captain login applications
loginClients.hint: Allow registered applications such as New API to use Captain customer accounts. Staff accounts, balances and subscriptions are not shared.
loginClients.setup: Configure New API Custom OAuth manually. Do not use OIDC discovery.
loginClients.mapping: Scopes: profile email. Fields: sub / preferred_username / name / email. Use client_secret_post or client_secret_basic. No ID token or refresh token.
loginClients.name: Application name
loginClients.callbackHint: Exact HTTPS callback, e.g. the New API site URL followed by /oauth/captain. HTTP is only allowed for loopback development.
loginClients.invalidate: Saving changes, rotating secrets or deleting an application invalidates its pending login codes and Captain access tokens. Existing sessions inside New API are unaffected.
loginClients.secretHint: Copy this secret now. It is only shown once and must be kept on the application server.

forwardConnectionCheck.hint: Checks this TCP endpoint from the preceding server. Save and apply new listeners before checking. Success does not verify the complete proxy path or forwarding firewall; test UDP with a real client.
forwardConnectionCheck.udpHint: UDP connectivity must be tested with a real client; a TCP check cannot verify this listener.

forwardAddress.internalHint: Uses the server’s registered internal address and actual listener port. Failed connections never fall back to the public address.
forwardAddress.missingHint: Set the internal address in the target server details first.
forwardAddress.candidatesHint: Internal mode for a single forward supports one target. Use forwarding groups for multiple internal candidates.
forwardAddress.fromPreviousGroup: How the previous group connects to this server
forwardAddress.realmHint: For realm private-network connections, configure an upstream exception for the destination address, protocol and port on the preceding server.
forwardAddress.nftHint: nft forwarding also needs the host FORWARD policy to allow traffic. Opening the listener port alone does not allow forwarding.
forwardAddress.usageError: Could not load internal-address references. Retry before changing this address.
forwardAddress.changeWarning: Saving updates these forwarding destinations and may interrupt existing connections. Confirm that the new address is reachable first.
forwardAddress.clearBlocked: This address is in use. Change or remove the referencing lines before clearing it.

nodeStorage.title: Storage display
nodeStorage.hint: Show capacity per mounted filesystem without adding pools and member disks together. Public pages show only short names and capacity; mount paths and device names stay in the admin panel.
nodeStorage.autoHint: Prefer the system volume and one main data volume. Recommendations update as the server reports filesystems.
nodeStorage.manualHint: Choose which storage spaces to publish and arrange their order. The first two appear on the homepage; expand to see the rest.
nodeStorage.noCandidates: No filesystems are available yet. Wait for the server to report them.
nodeStorage.empty: No storage spaces selected. Saving will hide storage information from public pages.
nodeStorage.name: Public name
nodeStorage.nameHint: Leave blank for the default name. Up to 32 characters.
nodeStorage.noMore: No other reported filesystems are available to add.

wgDevices.title: WireGuard device subscriptions
wgDevices.hint: Create a subscription for each device. Each WireGuard identity is independent, and usage is charged to the same account.
wgDevices.created: Device created. Wait for the servers to sync before connecting.
wgDevices.revoked: Device revoked. Wait for the servers to sync.
wgDevices.legacyHint: A WireGuard node in the regular subscription supports one independent client. Do not copy the same device subscription to multiple devices.
wgDevices.syncHint: Creating or revoking a device takes effect after the servers sync their configuration.
wgDevices.readOnly: Your role can only view the device list.
wgDevices.name: Device name
wgDevices.revokeHint: Revoke WireGuard access and the subscription for “{{name}}”? Its existing WireGuard configurations will stop working after the servers sync. Other devices are unaffected.
wgDevices.linkHint: This device-only link contains WireGuard nodes for mihomo/Clash, Stash, sing-box and Egern. Keep using the regular subscription for other protocols. For native WireGuard, select one node before downloading its configuration.
wgDevices.nativeHint: Select one node, then download and import the file into the WireGuard app. Each file configures this device for that node only.
wgDevices.serverHint: To use this WireGuard node on multiple devices at once, create a separate subscription for each device.
wgDevices.configUnavailable: A valid WireGuard configuration is not available right now. Refresh and try again.

reasons.no_wireguard: No WireGuard nodes are available to this account.
reasons.upgrade_required: The server and proxy core need an upgrade to provide WireGuard device subscriptions. Contact your administrator. Existing device records are retained.
reasons.unavailable: WireGuard service readiness cannot currently be confirmed. Try again later. Existing device records are retained.
reasons.client_chain_unsupported: WireGuard nodes with a client-side dialer chain do not support device subscriptions yet.

wgDevices.sharedHint: Device slots are shared with other registered clients.
wgDevices.selectionHint: Selecting all requires every authorized WireGuard node to be ready. You can also choose one ready node. Native configuration downloads require one node.
wgDevices.selectedNodeUnavailable: Selected node is unavailable; select again

serviceStatus.title: Service status
serviceStatus.hint: Manage the status of subscription nodes for customers. Status uses recent runtime reports; it does not guarantee end-to-end connectivity.
serviceStatus.portalHint: Signed-in customers see only their authorized subscription nodes in the portal.
serviceStatus.publicEnabled: Enable the public service status page
serviceStatus.publicHint: Anyone with the public link can see selected node names, categories, rates, statuses and maintenance notes. Server addresses and logs are not published.
serviceStatus.publicEntriesHint: Choose each node explicitly. New nodes and new category members are never added automatically; disabled nodes stay selected but are not displayed.
serviceStatus.publicEmpty: No nodes are selected. The public page will have an empty list.
serviceStatus.maintenanceHint: Set a time window for a subscription node. Times use your browser’s local time zone; each window can last up to 30 days. Maintenance changes the displayed status without stopping the service.
serviceStatus.noteHint: Plain text, up to 512 characters. Visible to customers who can view this node.
serviceStatus.duplicateMaintenance: Keep only one maintenance window per node.
serviceStatus.deletedHint: Remove deleted nodes from the public selection and maintenance windows before saving.
serviceStatus.reloadHint: Discard this draft and load the latest saved settings?
serviceStatus.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved. Reload the saved settings before editing and saving again.
serviceStatus.pathConflict: The public URL /service-status is already used by server monitoring. Change its URL in monitoring settings or leave the public service page disabled.
serviceStatus.previewHint: All enabled subscription nodes, using saved maintenance settings. Refreshes every 60 seconds and does not overwrite this draft.
serviceStatus.previewError: Status could not be refreshed. Old results are hidden until a fresh response is available.
serviceStatus.noEndToEnd: End-to-end connectivity has not been tested

validation.time: Enter valid times; the end must be later than the start.
validation.duration: A maintenance window cannot exceed 30 days.
validation.note: Use plain text with at most 512 characters and no control characters.

reasons.partial_unknown: Some candidate paths have unknown status
reasons.external_path: External forwarding path cannot be verified

branding.title: Brand settings
branding.hint: Shared by the homepage, customer portal, service-status page and admin console. The server probe can use its own branding.
branding.name: Brand name
branding.uploadHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP; up to 2 MiB and 2048 × 2048 pixels. Save settings to apply uploaded images.
branding.fallbackHint: A single logo is used in both appearances; leave both empty for the default icon. A square PNG works best as a browser icon.
branding.probeFollowHint: Use the main site’s name and icons. Turning this off restores the independent settings; switching does not delete them.
branding.uploadTooLarge: The image must be no larger than 2 MiB.
branding.invalidURL: Use an HTTP(S) URL or a site-relative path.
branding.independentInvalid: Independent branding settings are also preserved. Correct the image addresses below before saving.

mapLocation.title: Map location
mapLocation.serverHint: The map uses the server location, independently of flags and region groups. Correct inaccurate IP geolocation manually.
mapLocation.entryHint: Inherits the actual exit server location by default. Override special routes here; flags, routing and connection addresses stay unchanged.
mapLocation.coordinatesHint: City names are not converted to coordinates automatically. A city requires both latitude and longitude; country-only settings use an approximate country location.
mapLocation.homeEntriesHint: Explicitly select nodes whose location may be public. Publishes locations, without server IPs or connection addresses.
mapLocation.emptyMapHint: No markers appear when no nodes are selected or the selected nodes have no location.
mapLocation.statusSourceHint: Node locations include only nodes already published on the service status page. This does not publish additional nodes.
mapLocation.manualMapHint: Manual locations are retained when using node locations and can be used again after switching back.
mapLocation.siteConflict: Map settings or the node list changed. Your draft has not been saved. Reload and review the selection.
mapLocation.siteConflictHint: Reloading discards unsaved changes on this page and fetches the latest settings and node list.

validation.countryRequired: Select or enter a two-letter country / territory code.
validation.cityCoordinatesRequired: A city-level location needs a city name and both coordinates.
validation.invalidCoordinates: Latitude must be −90 to 90, and longitude −180 to 180.

mapLocation.stale: The current lookup is not up to date. The last successful location for the same IP is retained.

clientCatalog.hint: Check official stable releases, cache selected installers, then save the versions and visibility you want to offer. Checking or downloading does not publish changes.
clientCatalog.cacheHint: Hosted downloads use this server’s disk and bandwidth. Installer files are separate from database backups.
clientCatalog.pollHint: Progress refreshes for up to 20 minutes. Use Refresh status to resume; leaving this page does not cancel the download.
clientCatalog.downloadCompleteHint: The installer is cached. Choose it as a hosted download and save to offer it to users.
clientCatalog.nodesOnlyHint: Captain provides nodes for this client; its subscription does not include policy groups, ACL4SSR or DNS enhancements.
clientCatalog.fullConfigHint: Uses Captain’s {{format}} subscription format. Available rules and features depend on that format and the client.
clientCatalog.checkFailed: Check failed; the previous release and published downloads are preserved.
clientCatalog.archivedHint: The official repository is archived. Existing downloads remain available.
clientCatalog.downloadHint: Choose one system, architecture and package. Only the selected file will be downloaded.
clientCatalog.storeVersionHint: Download information comes from the official website or app store. Captain does not track the store-managed version.
clientCatalog.localHash: Local SHA-256 recorded; no upstream signature verification
clientCatalog.inUse: Selected for hosted distribution. Change and save the selection before removing it.
clientCatalog.removeCacheHint: Remove {{name}} from Captain? Official upstream files are not affected.
clientCatalog.publicationHint: Each platform has independent visibility. Save explicitly to apply these choices; disabled platforms stay hidden.
clientCatalog.conflict: These settings changed elsewhere. Your edits are preserved. Reload the current version before saving again.
clientCatalog.reloadHint: This replaces this client’s unsaved settings with the current saved version.
clientCatalog.cacheSelectionHint: Choose one or more cached installers. System and architecture stay visible to users.
clientCatalog.officialSelectionHint: Choose specific installers to pin their versions, or leave empty to link to the official release page.
clientCatalog.cacheSelectionRequired: Choose at least one cached installer.
clientCatalog.cacheNotReady: A selected installer is not cached. Download it first or change the selection.
clientCatalog.wrongPlatform: A selected installer belongs to another platform.
clientCatalog.invalidSort: Enter a whole number from 0 to 10000.
clientCatalog.customHint: Existing manual links remain in the user center. They are managed separately from the official catalog and are not cached or checked for updates.
clientCatalog.skippedInstallers: Installers omitted because their architecture is not recognized: {{count}}.

nodeAccess.title: Access scope
nodeAccess.all: All users with an active plan
nodeAccess.scopeHint: Access belongs to the inbound and applies to every subscription node using it. Display categories are separate.
nodeAccess.pickGroup: Choose at least one group, or select No access.
nodeAccess.sharedHint: This inbound is also used by these subscription nodes, including disabled nodes. Their access will change together:
nodeAccess.confirmShared: I confirm changing access for these shared nodes
nodeAccess.receiver: Internal receiver; not granted to users separately
nodeAccess.loadError: Could not load access settings. Existing permissions are unchanged.
nodeAccess.adminOnly: Access is managed by an administrator
nodeAccess.reloadHint: Access or related resources changed. Reload and review again. Reloading discards unsaved access changes.
nodeAccess.missing: Inbound not found. Close this dialog and select the node again.
nodeAccess.planHint: Shows access for the plan’s group; existing account groups also contribute to access. Includes disabled or unpublished inbounds. Actual subscriptions still depend on a valid plan, enabled nodes and chain dependencies.
nodeAccess.noPlanGroup: Without a group, only inbounds open to all active plans are included. Select a group to customize its available nodes.
nodeAccess.groupImpact: Changes affect every plan linked to this group. These plans share the same node permissions:
nodeAccess.noRelatedPlans: No plans are currently linked to this group.
nodeAccess.groupSaveHint: This saves group access separately from the plan form. Selecting an inbound grants all subscription nodes using it.
nodeAccess.allFixed: Inbounds open to all active plans cannot be removed here; change their node access scope first. Removing the last allowed group changes access to No access.
nodeAccess.confirmGroup: I confirm the changes for all plans in this group and nodes sharing these inbounds
nodeAccess.newInboundHint: Choose an initial group when creating. After saving, node access supports multiple groups or No access.
nodeAccess.connectionHint: For an existing connection, use the key button in Subscription nodes to change access. Saving connection settings here preserves its permissions.

settingsLayout.hint: Manage settings by purpose. Each module saves independently; unsaved changes are protected when leaving a category.
settingsLayout.search: Search settings, e.g. SMTP, branding, certificates…
settingsLayout.advancedHint: Expand only when needed for custom scripts and structured configuration.
settingsLayout.probeAudience: Server resources and network performance for maintainers, with separate visibility and branding.
settingsLayout.statusAudience: Subscription node status, public visibility and scheduled maintenance for users.
settingsLayout.saveBeforeRestart: Save the changes on this page before upgrading, restarting or resetting.

descriptions.site: Site branding, homepage content and portal appearance. Site settings and notices save separately.
descriptions.account: Registration, sign-in, trials and administrator access. Manage personal credentials in My account.
descriptions.subscription: Subscription delivery and client downloads. Node permissions and plan content stay in their own management pages.
descriptions.business: Purchase limits, remaining credit and referral commissions. Payment gateways remain in deployment configuration.
descriptions.proxy: Global certificates, connection logging and proxy policies. Per-server configuration stays in server details.
descriptions.monitoring: Manage server monitoring and user service status separately, with network checks and external heartbeats.
descriptions.integrations: Configure email, Telegram, event notifications and third-party login clients. Each module saves independently.
descriptions.maintenance: Backups, version updates and operation logs. Upgrades, restarts and resets affect the current session.

infraLink.supplierHint: Select a supplier and save to use its name and URL. Clearing the selection keeps the current text as unlinked data. Supplier changes also update a linked primary bill.
infraLink.operatorSupplier: This provider comes from the supplier directory. An administrator can change it.
infraLink.legacyHint: This text is not linked to the infrastructure supplier directory.
infraLink.newSupplierHint: Creates a supplier in the directory. Save this server afterwards to apply the selection.
infraLink.supplierCreated: Supplier created; save the server to apply it.
infraLink.linkedHint: Supplier, price, payment cycle and expiry are shared with this bill. Editing either page updates both without creating a payment record. When recording a payment, choose whether to update the expiry date.
infraLink.unlinkedHint: These server details are independent of infrastructure bills until you explicitly link a primary bill. Other assets remain independent.
infraLink.createAsset: Create bill from saved server details
infraLink.saveFirst: Save or discard server changes before changing the billing link.
infraLink.supplierRequired: Select and save a supplier first.
infraLink.structuredRequired: Save a structured amount and currency first. Legacy price text is not converted.
infraLink.periodRequired: Use a 1-month cycle or an exact multiple of 3 months, up to 120 months. Other periods cannot be linked without changing them explicitly.
infraLink.expiryRequired: Save a valid expiry date between 1970 and 9900 first.
infraLink.unlinkHint: Keep the current supplier, amount, cycle, expiry and automatic expiry setting on this server. The bill and payment history remain, but future edits stop syncing.
infraLink.createDirection: Saved server details → new primary bill. This creates a bill, not a payment.
infraLink.linkDirection: Selected bill → server details. Review the differences before applying.
infraLink.eligibleHint: Only active, unlinked bills belonging to this server or no server are shown. Their cycle must be exactly supported.
infraLink.confirmUnlink: Keep the current server details and stop syncing this bill.
infraLink.conflict: Billing or supplier data changed elsewhere. Your draft was kept. Reload the latest financial fields, review them, then save. Other server edits are kept.
infraLink.snapshotMismatch: The server and infrastructure snapshots differ. Refresh both before editing.
infraLink.operatorBilling: An administrator manages this server’s linked bill. Other probe fields remain editable.
infraLink.primaryNodeHint: This is the server’s primary bill. Unlink it on the server page before changing the server.
infraLink.inventoryNodeHint: Optional inventory association; this alone does not sync server billing.
infraLink.inventoryHint: This is an inventory association only. Use the server’s billing panel to explicitly create or link its primary bill.
infraLink.assetConflict: This bill changed elsewhere. Your draft was kept. Reload the bill before retrying.
infraLink.supplierClearRequiresUnlink: Unlink the primary bill before clearing the supplier.
infraLink.archivedLinked: Archived: data still syncs. Unlink the bill to stop syncing.
infraLink.savedRefreshNeeded: The link change was saved, but the updated server details could not be loaded. Refresh before making another change.
infraLink.linkedAmountHint: A linked bill requires an amount with the currency’s supported decimal places. 0 means free; unlink the bill before clearing it.
infraLink.renewalPreserved: The server’s automatic expiry setting is preserved. It estimates dates only; linking does not create a payment record.

infraPayment.oneTimeHint: This is a one-time asset. Recording the payment archives it, as before.
infraPayment.automaticHint: Automatic expiry extension is enabled, so payment-only recording is selected by default to avoid extending the date twice.
infraPayment.manualHint: The next billing date is prefilled. Review the actual renewal date and confirm it before saving.
infraPayment.setDateHint: Sets this exact date; it does not add another period. The date cannot precede the current expiry.
infraPayment.unchangedDate: Expiry stays at {{date}}. This records spending without claiming a paid coverage period.
infraPayment.invalidDate: Enter a valid date between 1970 and 9900.
infraPayment.earlierDate: The target date cannot precede the current expiry.
infraPayment.unavailable: The bill is missing or archived. The draft was kept; close this dialog and review the asset.
infraPayment.reloaded: The latest bill is loaded. Review the expiry action and target again; the old target and confirmation were cleared. If the currency changed, the amount was reset to the bill amount.
infraPayment.conflict: The bill or automatic expiry setting changed, or an earlier payment request may already have succeeded. Your details were kept. If the earlier result is unclear, check Payment history before starting a new payment. Reloading this bill keeps the same request ID; review the action and target again.

serverDetail.waiting: Monitoring data will appear after pairing.
serverDetail.offline: This server is offline. Check the sampling time of the last collected data below.
serverDetail.diagnosticWarning: The latest self-check contains items that need attention.
serverDetail.maintenanceHint: These actions affect server operation. Review them before continuing.

nodeInformation.title: Server information
nodeInformation.hint: Review saved information here. Edit to change display, traffic accounting and billing details.
nodeInformation.visibilityHint: Controls whether this server is listed on the server probe. The probe must also be enabled and its access rules still apply. Hiding a server does not stop collection or alerts.
nodeInformation.editBilling: Edit billing and primary asset link

serviceControl.title: Service control
serviceControl.policyHint: Uses the saved interface selection, counting direction, cycle and allowance above. Save changes to those settings first; this policy is saved separately.
serviceControl.scope: Controls Captain-managed proxies and forwarding on this server, including reverse tunnel exits. Management connections and monitoring remain available; unrelated host traffic is not controlled.
serviceControl.expectedRecovery: Expected automatic release at the next cycle: {{date}}
serviceControl.nextCycleRecovery: Automatic restriction is released when the next cycle starts.
serviceControl.manualPersists: Manual restrictions remain in place across traffic cycles.
serviceControl.pendingHint: The request is saved. The server has not yet confirmed application.
serviceControl.unknownHint: There is no fresh matching execution report. The current service state is not confirmed.
serviceControl.loadError: Unable to load service control. No control state is assumed.
serviceControl.monitorOnly: This server only collects monitoring data. Switch it to full server mode before controlling proxy services.
serviceControl.upgradeRequired: This bosun version does not report service-control support. Upgrade bosun to a version that supports it.
serviceControl.offline: The server is offline. Execution cannot be confirmed.
serviceControl.staleCapability: The capability report is out of date. Wait for a fresh server report.
serviceControl.platformUnsupported: The server platform does not support this control.
serviceControl.unpaired: Pair this server before configuring service control.
serviceControl.unavailable: Service control is not ready. It requires Linux, root, nftables and a separate non-root proxy account; check the server diagnostics.
serviceControl.rateHint: One shared upload + download limit for all managed proxy and forwarding traffic on this server.
serviceControl.policingHint: Packets above the limit are dropped. This is not a smooth bandwidth queue and may affect calls, games and other real-time traffic.
serviceControl.pauseHint: Pauses managed proxy and forwarding traffic, including existing connections. This does not shut down the server.
serviceControl.exempt: Temporarily exempt automatic restrictions for this cycle
serviceControl.exemptHint: The exemption ends with the current traffic cycle. Future automatic restrictions remain enabled.
serviceControl.exemptionRequired: An automatic restriction is still active. To restore service, explicitly exempt this cycle or change the allowance / policy first.
serviceControl.conflict: The control settings or traffic cycle changed. Reload the latest state, review your retained draft, then save again.
serviceControl.requestSaved: Control request saved; wait for execution confirmation.
serviceControl.policySaved: Automatic policy saved. Check the overview for its execution status.
serviceControl.staleTraffic: Traffic data is not fresh. Automatic control needs new valid samples; an existing restriction is not assumed to be released.
serviceControl.policyAction: When the allowance threshold is reached
serviceControl.autoResume: Release automatic restrictions in the next cycle
serviceControl.autoResumeHint: Only releases automatically triggered restrictions. Manual pauses and limits stay in place.
serviceControl.alertHint: Keeps the existing 80% / 100% traffic alerts, when enabled. This option does not restrict proxy traffic.
serviceControl.monitoringRequired: Enable monitoring before setting an automatic restriction.
serviceControl.quotaRequired: Set and save a traffic allowance above before setting an automatic restriction.
serviceControl.thresholdInvalid: Enter a whole percentage from 1 to 100.
serviceControl.rateInvalid: Enter a whole bandwidth limit from 1 to 1,000,000 Mbps.

probeThemes.title: Komari themes
probeThemes.hint: Install an original built Komari theme package. Each version is kept separately, so you can switch back without losing its settings.
probeThemes.isolation: Third-party themes need a different hostname from the administration site. A subdomain of your existing domain is sufficient and can use the same Captain instance: no new domain purchase or separate deployment is needed. Save the probe access domain above first; the main-site probe path keeps the built-in theme.
probeThemes.publicSettings: Settings are public. Do not include credentials or private URLs.
probeThemes.customSettings: This theme supplies a custom administrator interface. Captain does not execute it in the admin console; edit its public settings as JSON instead.
probeThemes.noSettings: This theme declares no managed settings.
probeThemes.sizeLimit: Theme ZIP must be at most 32 MiB.
probeThemes.installed: Theme installed; select and activate it when ready.
probeThemes.objectRequired: Settings must be a JSON object.
probeThemes.optionsFailed: Could not load available choices. Reload before saving.
